changelog: Aura AI v2.0.5 PRoot Ubuntu Engine, Pure White Theme & Refined Sidebar

PRoot Ubuntu Engine: Fixed isTermuxPackage so standalone com.aura.ai downloads Ubuntu 24.04 rootfs (35MB) and executes under PRoot glibc, completely eliminating 'libandroid-support.so not found' during shell verification
Local AI Engine Auto-Start: Automatic startup of agy_ide_bridge and AGY Hub on isolated ports 1244/1245 upon rootfs verification
Pure White/Light Theme Everywhere: Complete elimination of dark mode across all screens, settings, dialogs, drawers, and menus with readable dark status & nav bar icons
Refined Sidebar: Drawer background matching Chat/Voice off-white, 28dp rounded right corners with edge shadow, 24sp SemiBold Aura AI header, 44dp circular elevated search button
Soft 3D Elevated Style: White elevated 52dp menu cards (Images, Customize, Projects, Tasks, Plugins) with 10dp gap, 48dp gear and teal avatar, and 44dp blue text Retry pill
